title: brachyscome angustifolia var. heterophylla
intro: Brachyscome angustifolia var. heterophylla, commonly known as 'Bluebells', is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Brachyscome angustifolia var. heterophylla include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
